subject: SIG request: audit-ready VM proof pack, rotation schedule, and closure attestations
messages:
From: Evan Ortiz <evan.ortiz@valence.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG evidence for VM items — cadence, SLA, and closure attestations

Hi Laura,

Valence is kicking off our SIG review next month and the reviewers asked for a compact, audit-ready bundle that demonstrates:
- scan cadence for infra and container images (last 3 scans + schedule),
- CVE remediation timelines for critical/urgent findings in the last 90 days,
- any patch window constraints and SLA exceptions, and
- a signed one-page attestation that we follow our published VM SLAs.

Can Redwood provide a single download with: the last 3 scan outputs (raw), a CVE ledger showing ticket IDs and remediation owner/target dates, a calendar of patch windows for the next 90 days, and the attestation PDF? Our reviewers prefer a single zip with a top-level index file.

Deadline: reviewers want delivery by EOD Thursday 21 May if possible. If you need to stagger delivery we can accept the attestation and schedule first, and raw scans afterward, but callout any gaps.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Ortiz
Security Operations Manager, Valence Financial
secops@valence.com

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Ortiz <evan.ortiz@valence.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG evidence for VM items — cadence, SLA, and closure attestations

Evan — thanks for the heads up and the clear list. We can do this by EOD Thu 21 May; plan below.

High-level deliverables (single zip + index.txt):
1) scan-output-raw/ — last 3 weekly scans (infrastructure + container images)
2) cve-ledger-YYYYMMDD.xlsx — ticket id, severity, owner, status, remediation ETA, notes
3) patch-windows.ics — rolling 90-day windows; callouts for blackout periods
4) attestation.pdf — signed, one-page attestation of VM cadence & SLA adherence
5) index.txt — manifest + short README for auditors

Internal owners:
- Kimberly will assemble scan outputs and the CSV/Excel extract.
- Marissa will validate CVE statuses (open/in-progress/closed) and add notes for reviewer context.
- Ben — can you own the external delivery and the DocuSign/attestation flow? I can sign the attestation once the bundle is assembled.

If we miss anything, we will flag it in the index with an ETA.

Deliverable cadence:
- Wed 20 May EOD: draft bundle uploaded to a shared drive (internal review)
- Thu 21 May 12:00 PT: attestation signed & final zip uploaded to the link in this thread
- Thu 21 May EOD: confirmation to Valence with download link + SHA256 checksum

Ben / Kimberly / Marissa — please reply with confirmations and any blockers by EOD today so we can hit the timeline.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Looks good — confirming I will:
- pull the last three scan exports (infrastructure and container images) and place them in /shared/valence/vm-proofpack/scan-output-raw/ as compressed stubs (scan-extract-20260518.zip).
- generate cve-ledger-20260518.xlsx with columns: ticket_id, vulnerability, severity, first_seen, remediation_owner, status, remediationETA, notes.
- include links to Jira tickets where applicable.

Note: one high-urgency container CVE (CVE-2026-1458) was mitigated last week; we will include the patch timeline and closure evidence (build logs + image hash) in a nested folder. That proof adds about 30MB compressed.

I will upload a draft bundle by Wed 20 May 18:00 PT and will ping for internal review.

- Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Evan — forwarding the bundle we prepared for your SIG reviewers. Details below and direct download link. Let me know if you want a different file format or an encrypted transfer.

Bundle delivered (final):
- File: redwood-valence-vm-proofpack-20260521.zip (SHA256: 9f2a...e1c3)
- Contents: index.txt, scan-output-raw/ (3 scan exports), cve-ledger-20260518.xlsx, patch-windows.ics, laura_attestation_signed.pdf
- Drive link (short-lived): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/valence/vm-proofpack-202605/redwood-valence-vm-proofpack-20260521.zip

Quick notes for reviewers:
- CVE-2026-1458: mitigation record included in scan-output-raw/cve-2026-1458-evidence/ (build logs + new image digest).
- SLA adherence: snapshot of token-level patch latency is in index.txt (last 6 months median for high severity: 21 days).
- Exceptions: two scheduled blackout windows in June (see patch-windows.ics). Both were pre-authorized by Red Team and noted in the index.

If everything looks good, I can create a short cover note for the SIG packet or schedule a 20-min sync with your reviewers tomorrow.

- Ben
